item.title: Daphne police adding tools to arsenal against opioid crisis
item.description: DAPHNE, Ala. (WKRG) — The Daphne Police Department has more resources to tackle the opioid crisis, according to department officials. The department purchased five of the automated external defibrillators, or A-E-Ds. Two will replace older devices while three are new additions. The department used funds from the National Opioids Settlement to purchase them.
